# Flickbean

> Rub-not-tap idle game at https://flickbean.jonbailey.xyz/

v1.3.0

## Summary
Flickbean is a free browser game. Drag across the orb. Taps earn almost nothing. Rub fast for pops. Hold max speed to charge a frenzy prize. Buy Path upgrades. Unlock BEANMASTER, ORBITAL, then BEAN GOD.

Adults only (18+). A confirmation checkbox must be checked before play.

No account. Progress stays in localStorage. Made by @suddenlyjon.

## How to play
1. Press Start rubbing.
2. Drag, do not tap.
3. Heat builds toward a climax. Frenzy fills at max speed.
4. Spend rubs in Path. Daily Flick is a UTC-day distance goal. Claiming the next UTC day raises a streak. Miss a day and the next claim starts over. The streak adds a small bonus, capped after 8 days.
